## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] New user-visible text is in both `en.json` and `pt-BR.json`
- [ ] No new dependency, or the PR explains why it is worth trusting
- [ ] No network code (see docs/SEALED.md)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visual changes
